doc.title: Tyner McCoy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Siblings' music and his mother's beauty shop
summary: His brother drummed but turned to politics; his mother was a beautician and her shop later hosted his jam sessions.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: OK. Now were any of them musicians as well?
My brother studied drums, he had studied drums and that’s about it.
He was more involved in politics.
Yes, that’s right. He played drums but he got involved in politics.
And your mother, did she have a job as well?
She was a beautician. So her beauty shop was where I, as I got older and had been playing for a while, that’s where I had my jam sessions.
